# D02 分部积分公式

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D02Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("分部积分公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D02_1_1", "遇到两个函数相乘，求导会产生两个项。反过来积分，就能将一个积分转化成另一个。", "", tts_text="遇到两个函数相乘，求导会产生两个项。反过来积分，就能将一个积分转化成另一个。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"(uv)'=u'v+uv'", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D02_1_1")
        self.start_cue("D02_1_2", "当两个函数可微且所需积分存在时，可以使用分部积分。", "", tts_text="当两个函数可微且所需积分存在时，可以使用分部积分。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\int u\,\mathrm{d}v=uv-\int v\,\mathrm{d}u", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D02_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D02Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("分部积分公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D02_2_1", "对乘积求导公式两边积分。", "", tts_text="对乘积求导公式两边积分。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\int (uv)'\,\mathrm{d}x=\int u'v\,\mathrm{d}x+\int uv'\,\mathrm{d}x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D02_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D02_2_2", "左边还原为乘积，右边的两项分别对应 v d u 与 u d v。", "", tts_text="左边还原为乘积，右边的两项分别对应 v d u 与 u d v。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"uv=\int v\,\mathrm{d}u+\int u\,\mathrm{d}v", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D02_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D02_2_3", "移项得到分部积分公式。不定积分的常数最后统一处理。", "", tts_text="移项得到分部积分公式。不定积分的常数最后统一处理。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\int u\,\mathrm{d}v=uv-\int v\,\mathrm{d}u", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D02_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D02Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("分部积分公式", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D02_3_1", "例题：求 x 乘 e 的 x 次方的不定积分。", "", tts_text="例题：求 x 乘 e 的 x 次方的不定积分。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\int xe^x\,\mathrm{d}x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D02_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D02_3_2", "选择 u 为 x，求导后变成一；d v 为 e 的 x 次方乘 d x。", "", tts_text="选择 u 为 x，求导后变成一；d v 为 e 的 x 次方乘 d x。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"u=x,\quad \mathrm{d}v=e^x\,\mathrm{d}x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D02_3_2")
        self.start_cue("D02_3_3", "于是 d u 等于 d x，v 等于 e 的 x 次方。", "", tts_text="于是 d u 等于 d x，v 等于 e 的 x 次方。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\mathrm{d}u=\mathrm{d}x,\quad v=e^x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D02_3_3")
        self.start_cue("D02_3_4", "代入公式，得到乘积减去 e 的 x 次方的积分，最后补上常数。", "", tts_text="代入公式，得到乘积减去 e 的 x 次方的积分，最后补上常数。")
        self.play(FadeOut(line_1), FadeOut(line_2), FadeOut(line_3), run_time=min(0.35, self.cue_time_left()*0.15))
        line_4 = MathTex(r"xe^x-\int e^x\,\mathrm{d}x=xe^x-e^x+C", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_4, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_4), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D02_3_4", heading=heading, line1=line_4)
        self.end_cue("D02_3_4")
```
